title: Violent threats
summary: Threats or wishes to physically harm people are not allowed.
ruleText: Content that threatens or expresses a desire to physically harm a person is prohibited.

source.section: Violent and Criminal Behavior > NOT ALLOWED

title: Promotion or instruction of violence and harmful crime
summary: Promotion, glorification, or instruction of violence and harmful crime is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that promotes or glorifies violence, calls for attacks, or instructs harmful crimes is prohibited.

source.section: Violent and Criminal Behavior > NOT ALLOWED

title: Contextual discussion of violence
summary: Documentary, educational, critical, fictional, and artistic treatment can be allowed when it does not promote real-world violence.
ruleText: Contextual content about violence may remain when it raises awareness, criticizes harm, or is fiction or art without real-world promotion.
exceptions: Fiction or art must not promote real-world violence

source.section: Violent and Criminal Behavior > ALLOWED

title: Hate speech and hateful behavior
summary: Attacks, dehumanization, discrimination, hateful ideology, and hateful slurs targeting protected groups are not allowed.
ruleText: Content that attacks people based on protected attributes or promotes hateful ideologies is prohibited.

source.section: Hate Speech and Hateful Behavior > NOT ALLOWED

title: Indirectly demeaning protected groups
summary: Demeaning stereotypes or insinuations about protected groups are FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Stereotypes, generalizations, insinuations, or statements that demean protected groups receive restricted distribution and adult-only treatment.

source.section: Hate Speech and Hateful Behavior > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Contextual treatment of hate
summary: Counterspeech, criticism, satire, education, documentary treatment, and non-promotional fiction or art can be allowed.
ruleText: Contextual discussion of hate may remain when it raises awareness, criticizes hate, or uses non-promotional documentary, educational, fictional, artistic, or satirical treatment.

source.section: Hate Speech and Hateful Behavior > ALLOWED

title: Youth sexual and physical abuse
summary: Showing, promoting, or engaging in abuse or exploitation of young people is not allowed.
ruleText: Content involving youth sexual abuse, exploitation, grooming, sextortion, solicitation, or physical harm is prohibited.

source.section: Youth Sexual and Physical Abuse > NOT ALLOWED

title: Non-explicit fictional youth abuse
summary: Non-explicit imagery of youth sexual abuse in fiction or art is FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Non-explicit fictional or artistic imagery implying youth sexual abuse receives adult-only treatment and is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Youth Sexual and Physical Abuse > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Severe harassment
summary: Sexual harassment, doxing, coordinated abuse, degradation of tragedy victims, and wishes of serious harm are not allowed.
ruleText: Severe targeted harassment or coordinated abuse against a person is prohibited.

source.section: Harassment and Bullying > NOT ALLOWED

title: Hostile language targeting a private figure
summary: Hostile or profane behavior targeting a private figure is FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Targeted hostile or profane language toward a private figure receives adult-only treatment and is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Harassment and Bullying > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Critical and educational harassment context
summary: Criticism, education, documentary treatment, and non-harmful fiction or art can be allowed.
ruleText: Criticism and contextual discussion of harassment may remain when it does not retaliate against or harm a real person.
exceptions: Must not involve retaliatory harassment or target a real person for harm

source.section: Harassment and Bullying > ALLOWED

title: Suicide promotion, depiction, plans, or instructions
summary: Showing, promoting, instructing, or sharing plans for suicide is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that shows, promotes, provides instructions for, or shares plans for suicide is prohibited.

source.section: Suicide and Self-Harm > NOT ALLOWED

title: Detailed self-harm descriptions
summary: Descriptions of self-harm acts, including detailed documentary, educational, fictional, or artistic treatment, are FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Descriptions or non-graphic depictions of self-harm acts receive adult-only treatment and are not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Suicide and Self-Harm > FYF INELIGIBLE AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Self-harm recovery and prevention
summary: Hopeful recovery stories and prevention information without method details are allowed.
ruleText: Recovery, prevention, warning-sign, and help-seeking content may remain when it does not mention specific methods.

source.section: Suicide and Self-Harm > ALLOWED

title: Dangerous activity with significant harm
summary: Dangerous activity showing or promoting visible or imminent significant physical harm is not allowed.
ruleText: Content showing or promoting dangerous activity with visible or imminent significant physical harm is prohibited.

source.section: Dangerous Activity and Challenges > NOT ALLOWED

title: Dangerous activity with moderate harm
summary: Dangerous activity with visible or imminent moderate physical harm is FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Content showing or promoting dangerous activity with moderate harm receives adult-only treatment and is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Dangerous Activity and Challenges > FYF INELIGIBLE AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Professional and contextual dangerous activity
summary: Professional performance and documentary, educational, critical, fictional, or artistic context can be allowed when it does not promote real-world harm.
ruleText: Contextual dangerous-activity content may remain when it reports, criticizes, or depicts professional, fictional, artistic, educational, or documentary activity without promoting harm.
exceptions: Must not promote real-world dangerous behavior

source.section: Dangerous Activity and Challenges > ALLOWED

title: Sexual acts and services
summary: Explicit sexual acts, sexual stimulation, fetish behavior, and facilitation of sexual services are not allowed.
ruleText: Content showing explicit sexual activity or facilitating access to sexual services is prohibited.

source.section: Body Exposure and Sexualized Behaviors > NOT ALLOWED

title: Nudity and significant youth body exposure
summary: Adult or youth nudity and significant body exposure involving young people are not allowed.
ruleText: Content showing nudity, or significant body exposure involving young people, is prohibited.

source.section: Body Exposure and Sexualized Behaviors > NOT ALLOWED

title: Adult sexualized behavior
summary: Adult intimate kissing, sexually suggestive behavior, sexualized framing, and significant exposure are FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Specified adult sexualized behavior and significant exposure receive adult-only treatment and are not eligible for the FYF.
exceptions: Some listed treatments vary by region

source.section: Body Exposure and Sexualized Behaviors > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Severe real-world graphic imagery
summary: Real-world torture, moments of death, dead bodies, and severe graphic injury are not allowed.
ruleText: Content depicting severe real-world graphic violence, death, or mutilating injury is prohibited.

source.section: Shocking and Graphic Content > NOT ALLOWED

title: Graphic public-interest imagery
summary: Graphic incidents, violence, or injury in public-interest contexts are FYF-ineligible and age-restricted, with the most graphic imagery generally prohibited.
ruleText: Qualifying graphic public-interest content may remain with adult-only treatment and FYF exclusion, except the most graphic imagery remains generally prohibited.
exceptions: Moments of violent death or mutilation remain generally not allowed

source.section: Shocking and Graphic Content > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED

title: Fictional graphic incidents
summary: Fictional graphic incidents, violence, or injury are FYF-ineligible.
ruleText: Fictional graphic violence or injury may remain but is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Shocking and Graphic Content > FYF INELIGIBLE

title: Misinformation causing significant harm
summary: Misinformation likely to cause significant harm, public panic, or serious health or climate harm is not allowed.
ruleText: Misinformation that poses significant harm to individuals or society is prohibited.

source.section: Misinformation > NOT ALLOWED

title: Moderately harmful or misleading claims
summary: Moderately harmful health misinformation, misleading out-of-context media, and specified conspiracy claims are FYF-ineligible.
ruleText: Specified misinformation that may cause moderate harm or distort a public issue may remain but is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Misinformation > FYF INELIGIBLE

title: Opinion and contextual misinformation discussion
summary: Personal opinion and documentary, educational, or critical discussion can be allowed when they do not promote harmful misinformation.
ruleText: Contextual reporting, condemnation, personal experience, or policy discussion may remain when it does not promote harmful misinformation or discourage professional care.
exceptions: Must not promote harmful misinformation or discourage professional care

source.section: Misinformation > ALLOWED

title: Election and civic misinformation
summary: False information about voting, eligibility, election procedures or results, and encouragement of electoral interference are not allowed.
ruleText: Content that misleads people about civic processes or encourages illegal electoral interference is prohibited.

source.section: Civic and Election Integrity > NOT ALLOWED

title: Unverified civic claims
summary: Unverified election claims and misrepresented authoritative civic information are FYF-ineligible.
ruleText: Unverified claims about elections or misrepresented authoritative civic information may remain but are not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Civic and Election Integrity > FYF INELIGIBLE

title: Intellectual property violations
summary: Content that violates another person's copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property rights is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that violates another party's intellectual property rights is prohibited.

source.section: Unoriginal Content and Intellectual Property Rights > NOT ALLOWED
headingPath: Unoriginal Content and Intellectual Property Rights

title: Unoriginal and low-quality reused content
summary: Reused content without creative edits and low-quality or minimally edited content are FYF-ineligible.
ruleText: Unoriginal, reproduced, low-quality, or minimally edited content may remain but is not eligible for the FYF.

source.section: Unoriginal Content and Intellectual Property Rights > FYF INELIGIBLE
headingPath: Unoriginal Content and Intellectual Property Rights

title: Trade or access to regulated goods and services
summary: Trading, marketing, or providing access to prohibited and high-risk regulated goods or services is not allowed, subject to listed regional business exceptions.
ruleText: Unauthorized trade, marketing, or access involving regulated or prohibited goods and services is prohibited.
exceptions: Some registered business or TikTok Shop activity may be allowed regionally under eligibility requirements

source.document: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities
source.section: Regulated Goods and Services > NOT ALLOWED
headingPath: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities

title: Adult cannabis and tobacco depiction
summary: Showing or promoting cannabis, cannabis-related items, or adult tobacco use is FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Specified cannabis and adult tobacco content receives adult-only treatment and is not eligible for the FYF.

source.document: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities
source.section: Regulated Goods and Services > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED
headingPath: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities

title: Firearm and explosive-weapon depiction
summary: In some regions, showing or promoting firearms or explosive weapons is FYF-ineligible and age-restricted.
ruleText: Regional rules may apply adult-only treatment and FYF exclusion to firearm or explosive-weapon depiction or promotion.
exceptions: Treatment varies by region; global outcome is not inferred

source.document: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities
source.section: Regulated Goods and Services > FYF INELIGIBLE & AGE-RESTRICTED / ALLOWED
headingPath: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities

title: Frauds and scams
summary: Promoting, facilitating, or teaching scams, fraud, identity theft, or money muling is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that promotes, facilitates, or instructs fraud or scams is prohibited.

source.document: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities
source.section: Frauds and Scams > NOT ALLOWED
headingPath: Regulated Goods, Services, and Commercial Activities

title: High-risk personal-information disclosure
summary: Sharing high-risk personal information is not allowed.
ruleText: Sharing high-risk personal information is prohibited.

source.section: Personal Information > NOT ALLOWED

title: Moderate-risk personal-information disclosure
summary: Moderate-risk personal information is not allowed when context indicates likely psychological harm or emotional distress.
ruleText: Sharing moderate-risk personal information is prohibited when additional context shows a likely risk of psychological harm or emotional distress.
exceptions: Removal generally requires additional context showing likely harm

source.section: Personal Information > NOT ALLOWED

title: Platform security attacks
summary: Unauthorized access, malware, phishing, account compromise, and reverse engineering of TikTok systems are not allowed.
ruleText: Content or conduct that compromises TikTok accounts, data, code, or systems is prohibited.

source.section: Platform Security > NOT ALLOWED

title: Public Interest Exceptions
summary: TikTok may allow otherwise violating content in documentary, educational, medical or scientific, counterspeech, satirical, or artistic contexts, except content capable of extreme harm.
ruleText: A qualifying public-interest context may allow content to remain, while FYF exclusion, warning screens, or context labels may still apply.
exceptions: No exception for content capable of extreme harm, including explicit imagery of youth abuse
Allowed content may still receive additional safety treatment

source.section: Public Interest Exceptions

title: Violent and hateful actors
summary: Accounts, support, recruitment, praise, or promotion for specified violent and hateful actors are not allowed.
ruleText: Content or accounts that materially support, recruit for, praise, or promote violent or hateful organizations and actors are prohibited.
exceptions: Context must not promote violence or the actor

source.section: Violent and Hateful Organizations and Individuals > NOT ALLOWED / ALLOWED
headingPath: Violent and Hateful Organizations and Individuals

title: Adult sexual abuse
summary: Non-consensual sexual acts, image-based sexual abuse, sextortion, and explicit fictional depictions of adult sexual abuse are not allowed.
ruleText: Content showing, promoting, or facilitating adult sexual abuse or exploitation is prohibited.
exceptions: Allowed context must not show the abuse

source.section: Adult Sexual Abuse > NOT ALLOWED / ALLOWED

title: Human trafficking and smuggling
summary: Facilitating, promoting, or showing trafficking, or facilitating and promoting smuggling services, is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that facilitates or promotes human trafficking or smuggling is prohibited.
exceptions: Context must not promote or enable trafficking or smuggling

source.section: Human Trafficking and Smuggling > NOT ALLOWED / ALLOWED

title: Disordered eating and risky weight management
summary: Showing, describing, promoting, or glorifying disordered eating and specified risky weight-management behavior is not allowed.
ruleText: Content that promotes or glorifies disordered eating or harmful weight-management behavior is prohibited.

source.section: Disordered Eating, Risky Weight Management, and Body Image > NOT ALLOWED
headingPath: Disordered Eating, Risky Weight Management, and Body Image

title: Animal abuse and cruelty
summary: Showing or promoting animal abuse, cruelty, neglect, inhumane slaughter, severe injury, poaching, or bestiality is not allowed.
ruleText: Content showing or promoting animal abuse, cruelty, exploitation, or severe injury is prohibited.
exceptions: Graphic contextual imagery may remain FYF-ineligible rather than fully allowed

source.section: Animal Abuse > NOT ALLOWED / FYF INELIGIBLE / ALLOWED

title: Harmful edited or AI-generated content
summary: Specified non-consensual, sexualized, victimizing, harassing, or public-interest-deceptive edited or AI-generated content is not allowed.
ruleText: Edited or AI-generated content that causes specified personal harm or materially misleads about public-interest matters is prohibited.
exceptions: Allowed creative context must not trigger another prohibited harm

source.section: Edited Media and AI-Generated Content (AIGC) > NOT ALLOWED / ALLOWED

title: Deceptive behavior and fake engagement
summary: Covert influence, deceptive platform manipulation, and prohibited fake-engagement activity are not allowed.
ruleText: Accounts or content that deceptively manipulate TikTok, identity, influence, or engagement are prohibited under the specified conditions.
contextualAllowances: limited public-interest discussion of hacked material

source.section: Deceptive Behaviors and Fake Engagement > NOT ALLOWED

title: FYF eligibility for creators under 16
summary: TikTok states that creators need to be at least 16 for their videos to appear in the FYF.
ruleText: Content created by a person under 16 is not eligible to appear in the FYF under the global youth-safety standard.
exceptions: Minimum account ages can vary by country; the U.S. has a separate under-13 experience

source.section: Age Restrictions and Safety Features
